spellbook.finance/limitations: tier is the access the workspace has now, after any trial expiry. status is the stored plan status, and none means the workspace has no plan record.

scope is workspace; observedAt timestamps this read. activeUnitCount counts active units then. countIsExact false means it is a lower bound (10,001 means at least 10,001). cap is the allowance. headroom is admission capacity after reservations, clamped at zero; count exactness does not change it. overCap compares the observed count with cap. These are read-time facts, not a guarantee of later inventory or capacity. sellerSource names the access source.

enforcementEnabled reports whether the free Seller cap gate is enabled. A null transitionGraceExpiresAt means no grace deadline is recorded. A timestamp is the recorded UTC deadline; grace remains active only until that time passes.

claimed reports whether the owner of this workspace already claimed it for the one permanent free Seller allowance. It does not mean the cap rollout is enabled or that this caller has Seller entitlement; read sellerToolsUnlocked for that.

sellerToolsUnlocked reports the caller's Seller entitlement, not whether channel automation is enabled. This status does not prove checkout or payment settlement, and it does not report all-in Seller economics.
It returns no payment method, invoice, or Stripe identifier.

tier and status describe the workspace plan only. A person-level Pro plan also grants seller access, so tier free does not mean the seller cannot publish. sellerToolsUnlocked is the answer to whether they can.

description: Read one workspace's Store plan and Seller cap status: tier, stored plan status, trialExpiresAt, sellerToolsUnlocked, and freeSellerCap's scope, observedAt, sellerSource, activeUnitCount, countIsExact, cap, headroom, overCap, enforcementEnabled, claimed, and transitionGraceExpiresAt. A free owner must explicitly choose one workspace with spellbook_free_seller_workspace_claim before free Seller access begins. Read this status again after the claim. For a seller-requested paid Store plan, use spellbook_seller_plan_checkout_link when the stored plan is not active, then re-read this status.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to read the plan for. The caller must be a member. Required.

name: spellbook_workspace_plan_status
